event_data.context: Lazily create one Sprite per authorized coder child when first needed, with at most two live per user and four per deployment. Freeze private ingress and deny-all egress and verify both before snapshot upload. Keep the provider token host-side and mediate network access. Set a 60-minute lifetime and persist the binding keyed by authorized child run across retries and restarts. Route the existing file and shell tools to this workspace. Verify command termination on timeout/cancellation and reconcile interrupted runs and cleanup. Add deterministic adapter tests for retry, quotas, denial, failures, cleanup, and verified patch and bounded test-result readback.
event_data.summary: Add a host-mediated opt-in Sprites workspace backend with durable run ownership, quotas, and cleanup.
event_data.title: Run each coding workspace in its own Sprite
